findings.title: Ground-to-Sprite Disconnect
findings.where: Arena and Road screens, center vehicle placement
findings.problem: The vehicle lacks a contact shadow or ambient occlusion bake underneath it, making it appear to float above the tiling textures.
findings.why: It destroys the sense of weight and physical presence essential for vehicular combat, making the car feel like a flat UI element rather than a heavy machine.
findings.fix: Add a static, blurred dark elliptical shadow sprite underneath the vehicle that rotates with the chassis.

findings.title: Low-Contrast Environmental Tiling
findings.where: Arena and Road screens, ground textures
findings.problem: The concrete and asphalt textures use a high-frequency, noisy grit pattern that competes with the vehicle's visual detail.
findings.why: It creates visual 'vibrations' at speed and makes the vehicle harder to track during fast maneuvers because the background is as busy as the player character.
findings.fix: Reduce the contrast of the ground texture noise and add a subtle vignette or 'speed blur' effect at the edges of the screen to focus the eye on the center.

findings.title: Interactive Element Scale
findings.where: City screen, building icons and mission markers
findings.problem: The building sprites are disproportionately small compared to the vehicle and the vast empty space of the ground texture.
findings.why: The world feels empty and clinical rather than like a lived-in city. The 'New York' label doesn't match the visual of a few scattered gray boxes.
findings.fix: Increase the scale of building clusters by 1.5x and add secondary decorative 'rubble' or 'sidewalk' sprites around the base of interactive buildings to ground them.

findings.title: Information Density Imbalance
findings.problem: The weapon slot list (1-10) is a vertical wall of text with identical '(empty)' labels and no visual dividers.
findings.why: It creates 'wall of text' fatigue. A player scanning for their current loadout has to read line-by-line rather than recognizing shapes or colors.
findings.fix: Use a grid of icon boxes for weapons instead of a vertical list, or at least dim the '(empty)' text to 30% opacity to highlight active components.

findings.title: HUD Hierarchy and Separation
findings.problem: The armor and tire status use thin green bars and small text on a semi-transparent dark background that sits directly over gameplay tiles.
findings.why: In the heat of combat, the thin green lines are too delicate to read at a glance. The lack of a solid backing plate makes the text bleed into the ground textures.
findings.fix: Increase the thickness of the status bars (FL, FR, etc.) and add a solid, high-opacity dark backing plate to the entire Condition UI block.
